createWindow: Create a new async Qt6 window with a title, width, and height. Returns a QtWindow instance.
createWindow.addText: Add a text label (QLabel). Returns the widget ID (Number).
createWindow.addImage: Add an image (QLabel) from a filepath. Returns the widget ID (Number).
createWindow.addButton: Add a clickable button with a callback function. Returns the widget ID (Number).
createWindow.setText: Update the text of a widget (Label/Button) by its ID.
createWindow.setImage: Update the image of a Label by its ID.
createWindow.removeWidget: Remove and destroy a widget by its ID.
createWindow.close: Close the window and stop the background Qt event loop
